name: Tommy Muldoon
text:
[action] Spend 1 resource, or discard a [[Firearm]] asset you control from play: Play a [[Firearm]] asset from your hand, paying its cost. It enters play with 2 additional ammo on it.
[elder_sign] effect: +1. Place 1 ammo on an asset you control with uses (ammo).
backText: Deck Size: 30. Deckbuilding Options: Guardian cards ([guardian]) level 0-5, Neutral cards level 0-5. Deckbuilding Requirements (do not count toward deck size): Becky, Loose Cannon, 1 random basic weakness.
flavor: "This uniform means something. I'm reminded of that every time I put it on."

name: Becky
text: Tommy Muldoon deck only. Uses (2 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] When you trigger the above [action] ability, exhaust Becky: This attack ignores the aloof and retaliate keywords.

name: Loose Cannon
text: Revelation - You must either discard each [[Firearm]] asset you control or lose 5 resources.

name: Overconfident
text: Revelation - Put Overconfident into play in your threat area. Forced - After you fail a skill test: Take 1 damage. [action][action]: Discard Overconfident.

name: Police Dog
text: [fast] During an attack or investigation at your location, exhaust Police Dog: The performing investigator gets +1 skill value for this test.

name: Rookie Cop
text:
Rookie Cop may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] When Rookie Cop is defeated: Discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: Too eager to be cautious, too naive to know better.

name: Service Revolver
text: Uses (3 ammo). [reaction] After an enemy attacks you, spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). This attack targets that enemy. You get +1 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack.
flavor: It's mostly for show, but handy when you need it.

name: Protective Vest
text: [reaction] After you play Protective Vest: Search the top 6 cards of your deck for a [[Firearm]] or [[Upgrade]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: "Make 'em sing"
text: Parley. Choose an enemy at your location and test [combat] (X), where X is that enemy's remaining health. If you succeed, automatically evade that enemy and discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Bounty
text:
Fast. Play after an enemy at your location is defeated.
Investigators at your location gain a total of X resources, distributed as your wish. X is that enemy's printed health (to a maximum of 6).

name: Custom Grip
text: Fast. Play only during your turn. Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control. [fast] During your turn, except during an action, discard Custom Grip: Return attached asset to your hand. You may play a [[Firearm]] asset from your hand (paying its cost).

name: Iron Sights
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
[action] Exhaust Iron Sights: You get +3 skill value the next time you fight using attached asset this turn. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Physical Fitness
text: Move. After this move, heal 2 damage.

name: Restrained
text: Fast. Play after a non-[[Elite]] enemy attacks you. Automatically evade that enemy and attach Restrained to it. Attached enemy cannot ready. Forced - When the round ends, if attached enemy is not a [[Humanoid]]: Discard Restrained.

name: Stakeout
text: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +2 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, heal 1 horror.
flavor: "Well, look at that. Who do we have here?"

name: Adapt and Overcome
text:
Commit only to a skill test during an attack or evasion.
The performing investigator ignores the alert and retaliate keywords during this test.

name: Armed to the Teeth
text: While it is committed to a skill test on an [[Item]] asset you control, Armed to the Teeth gains [wild] [wild].

name: Police Dog
text: [fast] During an attack or investigation at your location, exhaust Police Dog: The performing investigator gets +2 skill value for this test.

name: M1911
text: Uses (4 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +2 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. Ignore the retaliate keyword for this attack.

name: Extended Barrel
text:
Fast. Play only during your turn.
Attach to a [[Firearm]] asset you control.
You get +1 skill value while attacking with attached asset.

name: On the Beat
text:
Fast. Play when your turn begins.
Until the end of your turn, you get +3 skill value while investigating or parleying.
flavor: "Police work isn't about catching people. It's about protecting your community."

name: Physical Fitness
text: Move. After this move, heal 3 damage.

name: Stock Ammo Reload
text: Place 5 ammo, divided as you choose, among [[Firearm]] assets you control.
flavor: More bullets than you know what to do with.

name: Detective Sherman
text:
You get +1 [combat].
Detective Sherman may be assigned damage and/or horror dealt to other investigators at your location.
[reaction] After damage is placed on Detective Sherman, exhaust him: Discover 1 clue at your location.

name: Endurance
text: Starting. (You may begin the game with 1 copy of a starting card in your opening hand.) [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [combat] for this skill test (+2 [combat] instead if this is an attack or evasion). [fast] Spend 1 resource: You get +1 [agility] for this skill test (+2 [agility] instead if this is an attack or evasion).

name: Stakeout
text: Investigate ([intellect]). You get +3 [intellect] for this investigation. If you succeed, discover 1 additional clue at your location and heal 2 horror.
flavor: "Well, look at that. Who do we have here?"

name: Indomitable
text: If an enemy has attacked an investigator at this location this round, Indomitable gains [wild] [wild] [wild].

name: Protective Vest
text:
You have 1 additional hand slot, which may only be used to hold a [[Firearm]] asset.
[reaction] After you play Protective Vest: Search the top 9 cards of your deck for a [[Firearm]] or [[Upgrade]] card and add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Thompson Submachine Gun
text: Uses (6 ammo). [action] Spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). You get +3 [combat] and deal +1 damage for this attack. [reaction] After you resolve the above [action] ability, spend 1 ammo: Fight ([combat]). This attack deals +1 damage.
